activities.text: Ran the schedule audit — Monday in Thunder Bay, five things on the calendar, and I moved today's dinner check-in from 12:00 to 13:00 so it wouldn't land inside the Braun lunch; the midday podcast at 12:15 still sits in that meeting and I left it flagged

Picked today's look — deep navy academic tweed blazer with gold trim and elbow patches, burgundy scarf, one Constitutional Law textbook — and set the car-start reminders, 08:25 for the morning block and 13:00 for Contracts
Sent Angie's morning text — Dad's birthday call at 08:15, Con Law, LRW and the Braun lunch all before Contracts at 13:30, Thunder Bay overcast at 4C and Ottawa at 7C

Morning briefing delivered — parkade day, leave by 08:35, with RJR-MacDonald and Dominion Stores due for Con Law, the example contract and Week 8 readings due for Contracts, and only the Week 7 Contracts pair overdue
Drive-Time Prep recorded for the morning block — RJR-MacDonald front and centre, because Alford is expected to go hard on it in Con Law at nine
Calling Dad for his birthday before class — Dmitry's birthday is today, November 9, confirmed last night, half an hour set aside for it
Car started and heading out by 08:35 — morning block at PACI runs Con Law, LRW and the Braun lunch straight through to 12:30
Con Law with Alford, 09:00 to 10:30 at PACI — RJR-MacDonald prepped, Dominion Stores alongside it
Legal Research and Writing, 10:30 to 12:00 at PACI, straight on from Con Law with no gap
Bail hearing feedback lunch with Prof. Braun, 12:00 to 12:30 — location still TBC, no office for her is published anywhere, so Tariel asks her himself
Reminder in the lunch gap — text Michelle Kaczmar about picking up the mini fridge, in the free hour before Contracts
Dinner check-in, shifted to 13:00 today — no dinner plan was logged this morning, so this is where the evening gets sorted
Contract Law, 13:30 to 15:00 at PACI — example contract in hand for class, Week 8 Privity and Contingent Agreements behind it
Classes done and home — free from here, with the Response Paper hanging over the evening

Response Paper window — due Thursday at 16:30 for Larissa Speak and still at zero from last night, so Monday to Wednesday evenings are the realistic writing time; tomorrow also carries the kids' bedding wash and fixing Rheia's dollhouse before Friday's arrival
Evening wrap — rewriting the house to match the day as it actually happened, family landing Friday the 13th on my mind, then hammock time
